what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Yemen.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR and IDMC gave the same figure: 4795983 people living in internal displacement because of conflict.
Refugees from Yemen live mainly in Somalia and the Netherlands.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Yemen in every year from 2008 to 2025, with Ansarallah, AQAP and other groups among the government's opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in 2015, 2017 and 2020.
Floods and wildfires are the disasters recorded for Yemen in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 175000 in 2009 to 4795983 in 2025.
New displacements from conflict were highest in 2015, the year of one of the largest changes in the data.

how.text: IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
The sources don't say where displaced people are living inside Yemen.
